name: Panitanki–Nepal Border National Highway
significance: NH 327B is a branch of NH 327. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs from NH 327 at Panitanki to the Mechi bridge on the Nepal border, across the river from Kakarbhitta in Nepal.

relatedRoads.label: NH 327 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Police Colony to Bagdogra
